newsitem.title: USA: Getty Communications Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Getty Communications Q4 net rises.

text.p: Getty Communications Plc said Tuesday it posted 1996 fourth-quarter net income of 888,000 stg, up from 90,000 stg in 1995.
Sales grew to 13.9 million stg from 11.2 million stg.

Based on a conversion rate of $1.7123 per pound, the London-based company said it posted sales of $23.8 million and earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization of $5.0 million in the quarter.
For the year, sales were $93.3 million and EBITDA totalled $17.1 million, it said.
Getty did not provide comparative figures in U.S. dollar amounts for the year-earlier periods.
The EBITDA margin increased to 20.9 percent in the fourth quarter from 16 percent last year, Getty said.
Getty provides visual content to advertising and design agencies as well as the publishing industry.
